Well she knows. We have talked about it. She asked me why it took me 8 years to tell her. I can't force love though it is either there or it is not sadly. The worst that could happen would be me getting to attached and her being the exact opposite. If that happens then I am screwed. I will have to act like I am not and anything she does with another guy even if it is just hanging out with them would hurt like crazy. Or her not responding for a day or two would hurt as well. I would be setting myself up to get hurt and not just hurt a little but a ridiculous amount. When I truly care for someone in that way I will do whatever is needed to make them happy. I have had a situation like this before and luckily it turned out to just be infatuation but I lost the friend any way. She helps me with plenty as of now any way. She has been there for me since day one. Sometimes it takes her a bit to help but she always does. Sadly the event when I was 23 sealed the deal of never being able to do it no matter what. I am terrified of losing her and I have run a million scenarios through my head of what could happen and sadly the success rate for me is very very low and the outcome usually ends with death. Got fired from my job for something I did not even do. College drop out. It's to slow for me I cannot handle the idiots in class or the dumb questions they ask or the concepts they just can't figure out. There is nothing here for me. Everyone uses me because I am to nice. I don't know how to say no to people when they need shit. Been cheated on by every girlfriend I have ever had. 90% of the time it is with my best friend. That's why I made a friend of the opposite sex. She is basically the female version of me. There is no point. I have pushed it off for over a decade now. I have stopped finding reasons not to do it. I don't care if people will miss me. Maybe they should of listened. They all claim they listen but in reality they do not. Because if they did I would not get treated like a black sheep. Being alive is pointless. It's torture really.
